unclear_rule: the answer may only be real if neither our CLIP model nor Smaug says AI (>= 0.5); otherwise unclear. Chosen on 25 Nov from two live test images (an AI doodle the combiner called real, and an AI image our CLIP model called real), not from the test folder.
row_rule: group all = every image; seen / unseen / one AI tool = only those AI images (accuracy = share called AI at 0.5), AUROC = those AI images against all real images; real photos = only real images (no AUROC)
note: Our models never trained on this folder. Smaug is pretrained and its training may include some of these AI tools, so its numbers can be too good. Proposed, to tune.
